name: Catalogue readiness score weighting
description: Asset readiness is calculated as a rounded weighted score: metadata 25%, evidence 30%, ownership 25%, and risk 20%; component completion ratios are rounded to percentages, with empty checklists scoring 100.

name: Catalogue metadata completeness criteria
description: Metadata readiness requires genre, mood, duration, and either a registration code or publishing identifier; missing criteria are recorded as missing information and the metadata score is the completed-check ratio.

name: Evidence and ownership completion criteria
description: Evidence requirements count as present only when their status is ATTACHED, VERIFIED, or WAIVED; ownership readiness is 100 only when at least one ownership record has ATTACHED or VERIFIED evidence, otherwise it is 0 and an ownership-evidence gap is recorded.

name: Catalogue risk score penalty
description: Risk score starts at 100 and subtracts 25 points for each unresolved existing risk plus 25 points for each newly generated readiness risk, floored at 0; unverified ownership creates a high-severity ownership risk.

name: Catalogue readiness state gates
description: Default readiness is NEEDS_REVIEW; any missing information sets MISSING_EVIDENCE, risk score below 75 sets ACTION_REQUIRED, and READY_FOR_ACTIVATION requires readiness score at least 85, evidence score 100, ownership score 100, and risk score at least 75.

name: Catalogue opportunity score rule
description: Opportunity score is assigned as 75 when the asset is READY_FOR_ACTIVATION and 25 otherwise.

name: Default catalogue evidence requirements
description: New creative assets are seeded with three evidence requirements: ownership or contributor context as a supporting record, metadata source or catalogue record as a document, and asset file/reference/storage location as a link.

name: Creative asset lifecycle transition map
description: Allowed lifecycle transitions are constrained: DRAFT to IN_PROGRESS or ARCHIVED; IN_PROGRESS to REGISTERED, PUBLISHED, or ARCHIVED; REGISTERED to PUBLISHED, ACTIVE, or ARCHIVED; PUBLISHED to ACTIVE or ARCHIVED; ACTIVE to ARCHIVED; ARCHIVED to ACTIVE.

name: Command centre health bands
description: Health scores are labelled Strong at 85 or above, Stable from 65 to 84, Needs Attention from 40 to 64, and Critical below 40; readiness distribution uses the same score bands.

name: Operational priority due-date rule
description: Actions with no due date default to Medium Priority; due dates within 7 days are High Priority, within 30 days are Medium Priority, and later dates are Low Priority.

name: At-risk and critical alert classification
description: An asset is counted at risk when risk score is below 75 or readiness score is below 65; critical alert count is unresolved HIGH or CRITICAL risks plus blocked actions.

name: Public catalogue inclusion and ordering rule
description: Only spreadsheet rows with Website Visible equal to yes are published; mood falls back from Website Mood to Mood / Theme to a default request message, and catalogue rows are sorted by a fixed genre priority before title.
